hostGates.requirement: stop marker causes bounded continuation, not merely hook firing
hostGates.observation: Mechanism demonstrated: Stop decision block caused an actual third MCP call with marker continuation. One request per session is enforced by the test fixture, not a verified client bound.
hostGates.remaining: Qualify production continuation bounds, cancellation and queued-input precedence through supported routing; literal model input remains unobserved.

hostGates.requirement: cancel stops automatic work and queued user input wins
hostGates.observation: Hook completed 7305 ms after Escape input was written to the PTY while the TUI rendered esc to cancel; no instrumented SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP was logged. There was no acknowledged session/cancel event and no second UserPromptSubmit observed. Cancellation and queued-input precedence remain unverified, not proven failures.
hostGates.remaining: Observe an acknowledged native session/cancel event and accepted queued input, then verify hook cancellation and input precedence. Retained KAS FQi source uses a fresh hook AbortController rather than the turn signal: a wiring concern, not proof of native cancellation failure.
